classification.difficultyReason: Apply the taught symmetric-root relationships to scaled and reciprocal roots, then reconstruct each cubic.

children.label: a
children.prompt:
Let $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$ be the roots of $2x^3-4x^2+3x-1=0$.
Find the cubic equation whose roots are $2\alpha,2\beta$, and $2\gamma$.

answer.worked:
For the original roots,
$$\begin{align*}
\alpha+\beta+\gamma&=2\\
\alpha\beta+\alpha\gamma+\beta\gamma&=\frac32\\
\alpha\beta\gamma&=\frac12.
\end{align*}$$
For the new roots $2\alpha,2\beta,2\gamma$,
$$\begin{align*}
2\alpha+2\beta+2\gamma&=2(\alpha+\beta+\gamma)\\
&=2(2)\\
&=4,\\
(2\alpha)(2\beta)+(2\alpha)(2\gamma)+(2\beta)(2\gamma)&=4\alpha\beta+4\alpha\gamma+4\beta\gamma\\
&=4(\alpha\beta+\alpha\gamma+\beta\gamma)\\
&=4\left(\frac32\right)\\
&=6,\\
(2\alpha)(2\beta)(2\gamma)&=8\alpha\beta\gamma\\
&=8\left(\frac12\right)\\
&=4.
\end{align*}$$
A monic cubic with root sum $S_1$, sum of pairwise products $S_2$ and root product $S_3$ has equation $x^3-S_1x^2+S_2x-S_3=0$. Therefore the required equation is
$$x^3-4x^2+6x-4=0.$$

children.label: b
children.prompt:
Let $x^3-3x^2+5x+2=0$ have zeroes $\alpha,\beta$, and $\gamma$.
Find a polynomial equation with roots $\frac1\alpha,\frac1\beta,\frac1\gamma$.

answer.worked:
For the original roots,
$$\begin{align*}
\alpha+\beta+\gamma&=3\\
\alpha\beta+\alpha\gamma+\beta\gamma&=5\\
\alpha\beta\gamma&=-2.
\end{align*}$$
For the new roots $\frac1\alpha,\frac1\beta,\frac1\gamma$,
$$\begin{align*}
\frac1\alpha+\frac1\beta+\frac1\gamma&=\frac{\beta\gamma+\alpha\gamma+\alpha\beta}{\alpha\beta\gamma}\\
&=\frac5{-2}\\
&=-\frac52,\\
\left(\frac1\alpha\right)\left(\frac1\beta\right)+\left(\frac1\alpha\right)\left(\frac1\gamma\right)+\left(\frac1\beta\right)\left(\frac1\gamma\right)&=\frac1{\alpha\beta}+\frac1{\alpha\gamma}+\frac1{\beta\gamma}\\
&=\frac{\gamma+\beta+\alpha}{\alpha\beta\gamma}\\
&=\frac3{-2}\\
&=-\frac32,\\
\left(\frac1\alpha\right)\left(\frac1\beta\right)\left(\frac1\gamma\right)&=\frac1{\alpha\beta\gamma}\\
&=\frac1{-2}\\
&=-\frac12.
\end{align*}$$
The required equation is
$$\begin{align*}
x^3-\left(-\frac52\right)x^2-\frac32x-\left(-\frac12\right)&=0\\
2x^3+5x^2-3x+1&=0.
\end{align*}$$
